listing.name: Cult Of The Circle
listing.summary: A small mod that adds a randomly occurring bar encounter with some strange cultists. If you pay tribute, the cult will reveal the loacation of one Great Circle you have yet to discover.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a random bar encounter with cultists who reveal the location of an undiscovered Great Circle in exchange for tribute.

description:
A small mod that adds a randomly occurring bar encounter with some strange cultists. If you pay tribute, the cult will reveal the loacation of one Great Circle you have yet to discover.

(Pay 20k credits / player level to receive an intel note on a gate you don't yet know about.)

Git repository
https://github.com/tp-81/CultOfTheCircle
